description: Vertical faces, coplanar slab ownership, reflected surfaces, independent mesh projections, and watertight cuts through existing edges and plane vertices.

mutants.test_case: Slab slicing reports vertical face centers and normals
mutants.rationale: Suppresses emission for valid vertical triangles while leaving the slab geometry path intact.
mutants.expected_failure: vertical_points.size() == 2 and center/normal assertions fail; no crash or exception is expected.
mutants.description: Suppresses emission for valid vertical triangles while leaving the slab geometry path intact.

mutants.test_case: Slab slicing assigns coplanar faces to their documented surface
mutants.rationale: Uses the bottom loop interpretation for top projection lines. The coplanar ownership case, selected by the common CTest label, detects the wrong polarity through its top/bottom occupancy and bounds; the pointer remains valid and this is not a crash-only oracle.
mutants.expected_failure: The coplanar ownership case loses or misplaces the upward top polygon; ordinary geometry assertions fail.
mutants.description: Uses the bottom loop interpretation for top projection lines. The coplanar ownership case, selected by the common CTest label, detects the wrong polarity through its top/bottom occupancy and bounds; the pointer remains valid and this is not a crash-only oracle.

mutants.test_case: Mirrored slab transforms preserve surface roles
mutants.rationale: Reverses the determinant correction, causing a reflected upward/downward pair to swap surface roles while preserving bounded geometry.
mutants.expected_failure: top/bottom occupancy or mirrored bounds fail ordinary assertions; no invalid memory access is introduced.
mutants.description: Reverses the determinant correction, causing a reflected upward/downward pair to swap surface roles while preserving bounded geometry.

mutants.test_filter: The cut preserves a plane vertex when adjacent facets cross the plane
mutants.description: Reverse half ownership only for a facet with one new intersection and one existing plane vertex. Both output indices remain valid, but the analytic tetrahedron half volumes or closed topology must fail.

mutants.test_filter: The cut keeps both halves watertight when the plane follows an existing mesh edge
mutants.description: Assign a below-plane facet exact edge to the upper cap channel instead of the lower channel. The public closed-mesh cut must preserve both closed halves and analytic volume.
